description: qou-avt1 formalize-first: under KC19 the counit->trace transport is an affine move of the loop weight, and the anchor wants <0.5% of that move -- the transport overshoots by ~300x.
verdict: OVERSHOOT (scope-(a)). Under KC19 the counit->trace transport IS just moving the loop weight w from 1 to z along an affine line. Solving the one linear equation L(w*) = F_required puts w* within ~0.15% of the COUNIT (w = 1), i.e. the data wants only ~0.3% of the counit->trace distance under C and ~0.4% under D -- the completed transport overshoots by ~300x and ~270x respectively. So 'the ladder transports the evaluation from the counit to the Markov trace' is NOT supported as stated: whatever the ladder does, it moves the evaluation a tiny fraction of the way. Separately (G2) the ladder factor is AFFINE in w while the ladder asserts a COSINE -- two different functional forms, agreeing only at isolated points. w* is a MEASUREMENT of what the current parameterisation demands, not a value; it is resolved no better than ce (1.45%), so no closed form may be quoted for it. Nothing wired.
